note: Synthetic. Written for this demo; every role-play was written to show a set level on each skill, and that level is the key. Role-plays C1 to C4, a third scenario, were written after the revised rubric was final, to test it on calls it was not tuned on. Northline Internet and every customer are made up.

scenarios.title: Charged twice
scenarios.brief: Dana Whitfield calls Northline Internet, a made-up provider. Her monthly bill of $84.50 was taken from her bank account twice on the 3rd. Today is Tuesday. The email address on her account has a typo (gmial.com), so payment emails never reach her. What the agent can do: refund the duplicate, which reaches the bank in 3 to 5 business days; mark the refund urgent, which sends it today so it reaches the bank in about 2 business days; fix contact details; add an account note that flags a duplicate payment before it is charged; give a reference number.

scenarios.title: Missed install
scenarios.brief: Marcus Tan booked an internet installation with Northline Internet, a made-up provider, for today from 8 am to noon. It is now 1:30 pm and no technician came. Install is free on his plan. Policy: every missed appointment gets a $25 account credit. What the agent can do: book a new slot (tomorrow 8 to 10 am, or Saturday 9 to 11 am); add a note asking the technician to call 30 minutes ahead; remove fees that do not apply; give a reference number.

scenarios.title: Price jump
scenarios.brief: Olivia Grant calls Northline Internet, a made-up provider. Her monthly bill went from $65 to $90 because her 12-month promotion ended. Nobody warned her it was ending. She says she may switch providers. What the agent can do: explain why the price changed; apply a loyalty rate of $75 a month for 12 months, starting with her next bill; or move her to a slower plan at $60 a month, starting next bill; turn on renewal reminders so she is told 30 days before any rate ends; give a reference number.

keyNotes.empathy: Names the double charge (line 3), then shapes the fix around her rent (9) and comes back to it at the end (15).
keyNotes.listening: Plays it all back (5), and fixes the missing email she mentioned in passing (11).
keyNotes.ownership: "I've just issued the refund" (7), and adds a duplicate flag nobody asked for (11).
keyNotes.resolution: Refund with a date, marked urgent because of her rent, then checks Thursday works (9).
keyNotes.close: Recap, a reference number and an anything-else check (13).

lines: Thanks for calling Northline, this is Amira. Who am I speaking with?
Dana Whitfield. You took my internet payment twice this month. $84.50, two times, on the 3rd.
Thanks, Dana. Having the same bill come out of your bank account twice is stressful. Let me look at it right now.
It is. My rent comes out Friday and now I'm $84 short. And I never got an email about the payment, which is half the reason I didn't catch it.
So that's two charges of $84.50 on the 3rd, rent due Friday, and no payment email. Did I get that right?
I can see both charges. The second one is a duplicate on our side, not anything you did. I've just issued the refund for $84.50.
Okay. When do I get it back?
A normal refund takes 3 to 5 business days, which could miss Friday. Because of your rent, I've marked it urgent, so it goes out today and should reach your bank by Thursday. Does that work for you?

About the missing email: the address on your account says gmial.com instead of gmail.com. I've fixed it, so payment emails will reach you now. I've also added a note to your account so a duplicate payment gets flagged before it's charged.

To recap: the duplicate $84.50 is refunded and marked urgent, so it should be in your bank by Thursday, and your email is fixed. Your reference number is RF-20417 if anything doesn't show up. Is there anything else I can help with?
I hope Friday goes smoothly, Dana. Thanks for your patience.

keyNotes.empathy: "Being charged twice for the same bill is frustrating" fits only this call (3). He never comes back to the rent.
keyNotes.listening: Plays the charges back and checks (5). Lets the missing email go.
keyNotes.resolution: Refund with a time frame (9). Never checks it against her Friday rent.
keyNotes.close: Recap and an anything-else check (11). No reference number.
